title: Built on CICS
technical_impact: CICS online programs depend on the mainframe transaction monitor.
business_impact: An important part of the system uses CICS, a technology that is hard to hire for and cannot be upgraded in place. Moving off it is a project, not an update.
recommendation: Treat leaving CICS as its own track in the roadmap, screen by screen or service by service.

title: No automated tests were found
technical_impact: 0 test files for 27,656 lines of source code. Regressions can only be caught by hand.
business_impact: Nothing checks automatically that the system still works after a change. Every change, and especially a migration, needs slow manual testing and still risks breaking things.
recommendation: Before modernizing, add characterization tests around the most used features and the hotspots.

title: 8 complex files change far more often than the rest
technical_impact: These files combine high branching with frequent edits: the places where defects and merge conflicts concentrate.
business_impact: A small set of files absorbs most of the changes and most of the risk. Every new feature that touches them costs more and breaks more often.
recommendation: Cover these files with tests first, then split them along their responsibilities before any larger migration.

title: No continuous integration pipeline found
technical_impact: No CI definition (GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines, Jenkins, GitLab…) builds or tests the code on each change.
business_impact: Builds and releases depend on someone's machine and memory, which makes them slow and error-prone.
recommendation: Add a pipeline that builds and runs the tests on every change.

title: 3 source files exceed 1,500 lines of code
technical_impact: Very large files usually hold several responsibilities, are hard to test and to review.
business_impact: Some parts of the code are too big for one person to understand quickly, which slows every change.
recommendation: Break these files apart when they are next changed, guided by tests.

title: No container or infrastructure-as-code definitions
technical_impact: The runtime environment is not described in code, so it cannot be recreated automatically.
business_impact: Setting up a new server or a test environment is manual work that only a few people know how to do.
recommendation: Describe the runtime in a Dockerfile or IaC as a first, low-risk modernization step.

title: No logging or monitoring library detected
technical_impact: No known logging, tracing or metrics library is declared in the manifests or configuration.
business_impact: When something fails in production it is hard to know what happened or how often.
recommendation: Add structured logging and basic health metrics before any migration, to compare before and after.
